sources.entry: Agentprobe — Free agentic commerce readiness scorer. Probes any seller URL across 13 signals (llms.txt, OpenAPI spec, MCP endpoint, catalog/quote/checkout APIs, payment rails, fulfillment proof) and returns a 0–110 score. Tells AI shopping agents which storefronts they can actually transact with. CERTIFIED badge available.

summary.name: Agentprobe
summary.one_liner: A free tool that scores any seller website's readiness for AI shopping agents, based on 13 probes that check whether an agent can discover, quote, and complete a purchase.
keywords: can ai agents buy from my site
use_cases: Check whether an online store is ready for AI shopping agents
Find which storefronts an AI agent can actually transact with
Audit a seller site's llms.txt, OpenAPI, and MCP setup
Earn a CERTIFIED badge for agent-ready commerce
Compare agent readiness across several seller URLs
summary.what_it_does: Accepts any seller URL and runs 13 probes covering discovery files (llms.txt, OpenAPI, ai-plugin.json, MCP endpoint, commerce.json), commerce APIs (catalog, quote, checkout), payment rails, refund/contact info, unsupported rails, unsupported claims, and fulfillment proof. It returns a score out of 110. Bands are CERTIFIED (85 or higher of 95), AGENT_READY (70–84), PARTIAL (40–69), and NOT_READY (under 40). The page also lists example scores for several sites, with agentprobe.fly.dev itself scoring 110/110.
notable: Scores seller URLs across 13 agentic commerce signals on a 0–110 scale
Four readiness bands from CERTIFIED to NOT_READY
caveats: The page does not state how the CERTIFIED badge is obtained or whether it costs money
The page does not describe how the score bands map to the 0–110 scale beyond the stated ranges, which use different denominators (95 vs. 110)
